recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce Device.subject or edit the commented legacy Device association block; future subject-target or relationship refinements should be handled in DeviceAssociation-specific issues.
issue_request: FHIR-32570 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification. It accepted using Device.associationState.subject from FHIR-36214 for the patient association, required removing Device.subject as superseded, and intentionally did not add Practitioner to the then-current Device subject choice.
initial_application: Jira points to PR #2014 commit 6a6ee72b710a54bcab359fd05e64db63365a12f3, which only made minor Device association cleanups. The substantive application was in nearby history: 5ffc19505fc915435cfd5d60c903cb4912672bec commented out Device.subject and redirected Device-subject to Device.association.humanSubject, and 67a7976ec9caae4ba35221b3a089835a8f7a7fa5 updated Device-patient accordingly.
additional_context: FHIR-36214 created the associationState backbone FHIR-32570 relied on; FHIR-34134 later renamed it to association; FHIR-38904 later superseded the Device-level association approach by creating DeviceAssociation and removing patient-identifying association data from Device. FHIR-39009 records the overlapping Device subject trackers and points to the FHIR-38904 disposition. These related decisions are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current fhir.ini lists Device and DeviceAssociation as active resources, maps Device.patient to DeviceAssociation, and current source has no active Device.subject, Device.association, Device.associationState, Device.associationStatus, Device-subject, or Device-patient definitions. DeviceAssociation has active associationStatus, subject, period, patient/subject search parameters, patient compartment membership, and Device narrative guidance.

related_jiras.note: Created the Device associationState backbone whose subject superseded Device.subject for the original FHIR-32570 resolution; already audited on the combined branch.
Renamed associationState to association and added bodyStructure before the later DeviceAssociation relocation; already audited on the combined branch.
Created DeviceAssociation and removed Device association data from Device to avoid patient-identifying information in reusable Device instances; already audited on the combined branch.
Documented the overlapping Device subject trackers and linked final resolution to FHIR-38904; already audited on the combined branch.
